declared: by Opus 5.5 in commit 3d72d43 (2026-10-01 22:01 PDT), before any model is fit on these rows
plan_ref: plans/FABLE_PLAN_2026-10-01.md §3 B2 decision 4, §6 (Pomázi loop); round budget 2
gate: G2 go/no-go is >= 50 samples with all four outputs: 63 (pHRR 75). GO.
dataset: data/v2/pomazi_recon_inputs.csv (from derive_pomazi_inputs.py); per target: has_inputs AND target not null AND dup_of empty. pHRR 75 rows / 46 formulations; TTI, THR, CR 63 / 38. Independent reconstruction from the group's open publications + Toldy 2017 thesis; overlaps but is not identical to their 75 samples; their 4 RDP validation composites are not included.
features: The inputs Pomázi 2026 §3.1 lists: epoxy_ratio_pct, hardener_ratio_pct, fr1_ratio_pct, fr2_ratio_pct, C_pct, H_pct, O_pct, N_pct, P_pct, aliphatic_pct, cycloaliphatic_pct, aromatic_pct, heat_flux_kWm2, fibre_wtpct_input. The text names these 14 while stating '15 input parameters'; the 15th is unidentified and not used. NaN allowed for the 5 non-core tabulated rows' ratio inputs; no other imputation except where a candidate says so.
group: formulation = the 8 composition inputs rounded to 0.1 (a matrix and every composite made from it, and repeat measurements of it across papers, share one group)

protocols.A_theirs: random 80/20 split repeated 50 times (seeds 0-49); report mean and 2.5/97.5 percentiles of test R2. For comparison with their numbers only.
protocols.B_primary: GroupKFold by formulation, 5 folds x 10 repeats (shuffle, random_state=r), pooled OOF R2 per repeat; 95% CI = formulation bootstrap (2000, seed 0) of repeat-0 OOF, i.e. eval_protocol.bootstrap_ci with groups=formulation. Basis for any claim.
protocols.C_diagnostic: leave-one-resin-system-out (PER/T58, GER/T58, SPE/T58, GFTE/DETDA, other): pooled OOF R2

candidates.desc: sklearn GradientBoostingRegressor with their Table 1 XGBoost settings per target (n_estimators, learning_rate, max_depth=3, subsample; colsample_bytree -> max_features fraction), random_state=0; NaN rows' ratio inputs filled with in-fold training median (GBR cannot take NaN). xgboost is not installed; this is a stand-in and is labelled so.
StandardScaler + Ridge(alpha=1.0), in-fold median fill; linear baseline

target_transform: none for round 1 (raw units), all targets
selection_rule: Per target, highest protocol-B mean. No tuning in round 1.
round2_condition: Only for a target whose round-1 best protocol-B mean is within 0.10 of its bar: small nested Optuna budget (50 trials) or stacking, pre-declared separately.
exit_triggers: Any protocol-B ci_lo above its bar -> EXIT 5. Any protocol-A mean above its bar -> also EXIT 5 (it is the number people will compare with theirs).
claim_wording_if_triggered: 'on an independent reconstruction of the competitor's population (N samples from the group's open publications), under their random-split protocol / under a harder formulation-grouped protocol' — never 'beats', comparable stays pending-human
